simple.meaning: צְמִיתֻת (tsᵉmîythuth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “excision , i.e. destruction ; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction , i.e. perpetually.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 25:23. The surrounding context includes city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְמִיתֻת (H6783) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
